text:
Alice Nguyen: Heads-up: we're planning a migration tonight for user_events partition key + PK swap. Needs a short quiesce and a controlled backfill. Window: 00:30-02:00 UTC. I'll post the rollback/kill criteria below. @sre-oncall please watch locks :eyes:
Ben Kim: Question — will this require a full table lock or just metadata locks?
Alice Nguyen: Should be metadata locks for DDL, but backfill updates will take row-level locks. Risk is long-running UPDATEs on hot tenants.
Carmen Rios: What model are we using for backfill? batched UPDATEs or CREATE TABLE AS + swap?
Alice Nguyen: We're doing staged CTAS for most shards, but for small tenant shards we'll run an UPDATE path. CTAS avoids long row locks but needs copy window.
Dave Lee: Suggest pinning the runtime to inference-runtime v2.4.1 for the window to avoid recent KV-cache changes; ops has seen one edge case with 2.5.
Carmen Rios: +1 on pin. Also add statement_timeout on backfill sessions so they don't pile up.
Dave Lee: I'll add this to the deploy notes: 
```
-- backfill session wrapper
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '30000'; -- 30s
BEGIN;
-- run batched update
COMMIT;
```
Ben Kim: Deploy-bot — schedule?
deploy-bot: Deployment queued by alice_nguyen for 00:30 UTC. Release tag: user-events-pk-swap@2024-06-16. Canary on 2% of traffic at 00:35 UTC.
Alice Nguyen: Rollback criteria (quick):
- any shard backfill that shows repeated metadata lock > 60s for > 3 attempts
- replica lag > 30s and increasing for 10m
- > 3 long-running queries (> 120s) touching user_events in primary DB
If hit, abort backfill, mark migration paused, and rollback DB change via safe revert migration.
Ben Kim: If we abort, what about partial CTAS swaps? do we have a quick revert?
Alice Nguyen: CTAS swap is done with atomic rename, so we can rename back old table. We'll keep old tables with suffix _pre_mig for 24h.
Carmen Rios: Can SRE set up a lockwatcher alert so we don't rely on manual eyeballs?
sre-oncall: I'll enable a temporary lockwatcher for that topology and add a PagerDuty rule for lock spikes > 45s. Will also post Prometheus query in #eng-sre.
Ben Kim: Add an outage note for product that we expect < 2 min write delay for affected tenants during the swap. I'll draft release notes.
Alice Nguyen: Release notes draft: "Switch user_events partitioning to tenant-based partition key. Added PK swap path and staged backfill. Small possibility of short write delays for heavy tenants; rollback plan in place."
Dave Lee: One more safety: run a dry-run CTAS on a recent snapshot in staging with production-ish size. Carmen, can you run that now?
Carmen Rios: Running staging dry-run, will report completion in ~20m.
Ben Kim: Thanks — once Carmen confirms, I'll mark the deploy as GO in the release checklist. :thumbsup:
Alice Nguyen: Final checklist I added to the release: pin runtime, add statement_timeout wrapper, enable lockwatcher, keep _pre_mig tables for 24h, canary at 2%, abort thresholds documented.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 00:35 UTC. Canary traffic: 2%. Jobs: backfill-shard-1 queued.
Carmen Rios: Dry-run done on staging. CTAS completed in expected window (4m per shard). No long locks observed.
Ben Kim: GO from me.
Alice Nguyen: GO from me as well. Thanks team — will update thread if anything unexpected.
